verdict.rationale: Godot's official GitHub description explicitly states one-click export to desktop (Linux/macOS/Windows), mobile (Android/iOS), web, and consoles from a single project, matching the studio-lead's cross-platform export need, and the license docs/MIT confirm no barriers to shipping across platforms. No community evidence contradicts console or desktop/mobile export capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of console export specifically (which in practice goes through third-party console partners), and more detail on the partner/porting process for consoles beyond the single GitHub line.
